affected_system: municipal buildings, distributed energy, electrification, and emissions management
alternatives: compare eligible treated and credible untreated units for phased municipal building energy retrofit
estimate pre-specified overall and distributional effects of phased municipal building energy retrofit
pair matched building difference-in-differences with meter panels with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Meters, fuels, tariffs, weather, occupancy, equipment, projects, and emissions factors are versioned.
Modeled energy and carbon savings remain distinct from measured post-project performance.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: retain pre-intervention conditions for phased municipal building energy retrofit.

constraints.description: The municipal energy and building decarbonization evaluate must respect declared pre-specified assignment, comparison, outcome, spillover, and subgroup rules.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: municipal energy director and public-building portfolio manager
decision_question: Did phased retrofits reduce weather-normalized energy and emissions while preserving comfort and service?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The municipal energy and building decarbonization evaluate must respect declared pre-specified assignment, comparison, outcome, spillover, and subgroup rules.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for phased municipal building energy retrofit passes documented checks for dated assignment, comparison validity, pre-trends, outcome panels, attrition, spillovers, and falsification tests.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: matched building difference-in-differences with meter panels
independence_key.primary_outcome: change in weather- and occupancy-normalized energy use

intended_claim: A versioned evaluate design for comparing declared alternatives affecting phased municipal building energy retrofit, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: change in weather- and occupancy-normalized energy use
distributional gap in change in weather- and occupancy-normalized energy use
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not infer causal carbon, cost, or comfort effects without stable meters, factors, occupancy, and comparisons.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for phased municipal building energy retrofit passes documented checks for dated assignment, comparison validity, pre-trends, outcome panels, attrition, spillovers, and falsification tests.

title: Evaluate municipal building retrofit performance
transportability_risks: Climate, grids, tariffs, fuels, building codes, stock, occupancy, and finance differ.
Operational changes can confound retrofit performance comparisons.
